items.title: A Protein Icon That Isn't a Drop
items.why: In My Goals, Protein uses a water drop, the same one Water uses in Quick Add, and at this size it looks a lot like the Calories flame just below it. A different shape for Protein would make the three easy to tell apart. These are drawn in Goku's own outline style. Calories and Water stay as they are.

options.label: Drumstick
options.desc: Reads as food with protein. The same icon would go wherever Protein shows an icon.

options.label: Shaker bottle
options.desc: A protein-shake bottle. Clear, but it hints at supplements.
